daily.en: A short daily review can help students remember new vocabulary.
daily.zh: 每天做一點簡短複習能幫助學生記住新單字。

damage.en: Heavy rain caused serious damage to several mountain roads.
damage.zh: 大雨對幾條山區道路造成嚴重損害。

dance.en: The students learned a traditional dance for the school festival.
dance.zh: 學生為校慶學了一支傳統舞蹈。

danger.en: The sign warns visitors about the danger of falling rocks.
danger.zh: 這個標誌提醒遊客注意落石危險。

dangerous.en: It is dangerous to use electrical equipment near water.
dangerous.zh: 在水邊使用電器設備很危險。

dark.en: The room became dark when the power suddenly went out.
dark.zh: 突然停電時，房間變得一片漆黑。

data.en: The researchers checked the data carefully before drawing conclusions.
data.zh: 研究人員在下結論前仔細檢查資料。

date.en: Please write the date at the top of your worksheet.
date.zh: 請在學習單上方寫上日期。

daughter.en: His daughter enjoys reading science books after school.
daughter.zh: 他的女兒放學後喜歡閱讀科學書籍。

day.en: We spent the whole day preparing for the presentation.
day.zh: 我們花了一整天準備報告。

dead.en: The plant was dead because it had not received enough water.
dead.zh: 這株植物因為沒有得到足夠的水而枯死。

deal.en: The class discussed how to deal with stress before exams.
deal.zh: 全班討論考試前如何處理壓力。

dear.en: She wrote a short letter beginning with Dear Grandma.
dear.zh: 她寫了一封以親愛的奶奶開頭的短信。

death.en: The article explains how pollution can increase the risk of early death.
death.zh: 這篇文章說明污染如何增加早逝風險。

debate.en: The students held a debate about whether uniforms should be required.
debate.zh: 學生就是否應要求穿制服進行辯論。

debt.en: The family worked hard to reduce its debt over several years.
debt.zh: 這個家庭花了好幾年努力減少債務。

decade.en: The city has changed greatly over the past decade.
decade.zh: 這座城市在過去十年間有很大變化。

December.en: The final exam will take place in December this year.
December.zh: 今年的期末考會在十二月舉行。

decide.en: We need more information before we decide what to do.
decide.zh: 我們需要更多資訊才能決定要怎麼做。

decision.en: She made her decision after comparing all three options.
decision.zh: 她比較三個選項後做出了決定。

declare.en: The officials will declare the final results tomorrow morning.
declare.zh: 相關人員會在明天早上宣布最終結果。

decline.en: The report shows a decline in plastic waste after the new policy.
decline.zh: 報告顯示新政策實施後塑膠垃圾有所下降。

decorate.en: Students helped decorate the classroom for the graduation celebration.
decorate.zh: 學生幫忙布置教室以迎接畢業慶祝活動。

decrease.en: The new system helped decrease waiting time at the school office.
decrease.zh: 新系統幫助縮短了校務處的等候時間。

deep.en: The lake is too deep to cross safely on foot.
deep.zh: 這座湖太深，無法安全徒步穿越。

deeply.en: The documentary deeply affected many students in the audience.
deeply.zh: 這部紀錄片深深影響了許多在場學生。

defeat.en: The team refused to give up after its first defeat.
defeat.zh: 球隊在第一次落敗後仍拒絕放棄。

defend.en: The lawyer used strong evidence to defend the accused person.
defend.zh: 律師用有力證據為被告辯護。

defense.en: Good defense helped the team protect its narrow lead.
defense.zh: 良好的防守幫助球隊守住微弱領先。

define.en: Please define the key term before using it in your essay.
define.zh: 在文章中使用這個關鍵詞前，請先加以定義。

definite.en: We need a definite answer before booking the tickets.
definite.zh: 我們需要明確答案後才能訂票。

definitely.en: This method will definitely save time if used correctly.
definitely.zh: 如果正確使用，這個方法一定能節省時間。

degree.en: The temperature rose by several degrees during the afternoon.
degree.zh: 下午氣溫上升了好幾度。

delay.en: Heavy traffic caused a delay of nearly thirty minutes.
delay.zh: 交通壅塞造成將近三十分鐘的延誤。

deliberate.en: The committee made a deliberate choice after reviewing all the evidence.
deliberate.zh: 委員會在審查所有證據後做出了審慎的選擇。

delicate.en: The glass model is delicate and should be handled carefully.
delicate.zh: 這個玻璃模型很脆弱，應小心拿取。

delicious.en: The soup was simple but surprisingly delicious.
delicious.zh: 這道湯很簡單，卻意外地美味。

deliver.en: The company will deliver the new computers to school next week.
deliver.zh: 公司下週會把新電腦送到學校。

delivery.en: The delivery arrived earlier than the office had expected.
delivery.zh: 這批貨比辦公室預期更早送達。

demand.en: There is growing demand for cleaner sources of energy.
demand.zh: 人們對更潔淨能源的需求正在增加。

demonstrate.en: The teacher used a model to demonstrate how the machine works.
demonstrate.zh: 老師用模型示範這台機器如何運作。

deny.en: He did not deny making the mistake in the report.
deny.zh: 他沒有否認自己在報告中犯了錯。

department.en: The science department organized a special lecture for students.
department.zh: 自然科部門為學生舉辦了一場特別講座。

depend.en: The final result will depend on how carefully we collect the data.
depend.zh: 最後結果將取決於我們蒐集資料時有多仔細。

dependent.en: Young children are often dependent on adults for daily care.
dependent.zh: 年幼兒童的日常照顧常依賴成年人。

deposit.en: You need to pay a small deposit before borrowing the equipment.
deposit.zh: 借用設備前需要先支付一小筆押金。

depress.en: Long periods of bad weather can depress people's mood.
depress.zh: 長時間的壞天氣可能使人的情緒低落。

depth.en: The students measured the depth of the water near the shore.
depth.zh: 學生測量了岸邊水域的深度。

describe.en: Please describe what you observed during the experiment.
describe.zh: 請描述你在實驗中觀察到的現象。

description.en: The website provides a short description of each course.
description.zh: 網站提供每門課的簡短說明。

desert.en: Very little rain falls in this desert each year.
desert.zh: 這片沙漠每年的降雨量很少。

deserve.en: Students who worked hard deserve recognition for their effort.
deserve.zh: 努力付出的學生值得因他們的努力受到肯定。

design.en: Students helped design a poster for the environmental campaign.
design.zh: 學生協助設計環保活動海報。

designer.en: The designer created a simple layout that was easy to read.
designer.zh: 設計師做出了一個簡單而容易閱讀的版面。

desire.en: Her desire to improve motivated her to practice every day.
desire.zh: 她想進步的渴望促使她每天練習。

desk.en: My notes were still on the desk after class ended.
desk.zh: 下課後我的筆記還放在桌上。

despite.en: Despite the rain, the outdoor event continued as planned.
despite.zh: 儘管下雨，戶外活動仍照計畫進行。

destroy.en: A strong earthquake can destroy poorly built structures.
destroy.zh: 強烈地震可能摧毀結構不良的建築。

detail.en: Please include enough detail to make your explanation clear.
detail.zh: 請提供足夠細節，讓你的解釋更清楚。

detailed.en: The guide gives detailed instructions for each step of the process.
detailed.zh: 這份指南提供每個步驟的詳細說明。

detect.en: The new sensor can detect small changes in temperature.
detect.zh: 這個新感測器能偵測細微的溫度變化。

determine.en: The test will help determine which method is more effective.
determine.zh: 這項測試將幫助判斷哪種方法更有效。

develop.en: Students need time to develop strong reading habits.
develop.zh: 學生需要時間培養良好的閱讀習慣。

development.en: The report examines the development of public transportation in the city.
development.zh: 這份報告探討這座城市大眾運輸的發展。

device.en: This device measures air quality inside the classroom.
device.zh: 這個裝置用來測量教室內的空氣品質。

devote.en: She decided to devote more time to improving her writing.
devote.zh: 她決定投入更多時間提升寫作能力。

dialogue.en: The story uses dialogue to show the characters' different opinions.
dialogue.zh: 故事透過對話呈現角色不同的意見。

dictionary.en: Use a dictionary when the context does not reveal the word's meaning.
dictionary.zh: 當語境無法看出單字意思時，可以查字典。

die.en: Some plants die quickly if they receive too little sunlight.
die.zh: 有些植物若得到太少陽光會很快枯死。

diet.en: A balanced diet should include several different kinds of food.
diet.zh: 均衡飲食應包含多種不同食物。

differ.en: The two plans differ mainly in cost and schedule.
differ.zh: 這兩個方案主要在成本和時程上不同。

difference.en: The graph shows a clear difference between the two groups.
difference.zh: 這張圖表顯示兩組之間有明顯差異。

different.en: Different students may learn best in different ways.
different.zh: 不同學生最適合的學習方式可能不同。

difficult.en: The final question was difficult but not impossible to solve.
difficult.zh: 最後一題很難，但並不是無法解決。

difficulty.en: She had difficulty understanding the article without background knowledge.
difficulty.zh: 沒有背景知識時，她很難理解這篇文章。

digital.en: The school introduced digital textbooks in several classes this year.
digital.zh: 學校今年在幾個班級導入數位教科書。

dinner.en: We discussed the trip while eating dinner together.
dinner.zh: 我們一起吃晚餐時討論了這趟旅程。

direct.en: The teacher gave direct instructions before the experiment began.
direct.zh: 實驗開始前，老師給了明確直接的指示。

direction.en: The sign points in the direction of the train station.
direction.zh: 這個標誌指向火車站的方向。

directly.en: Please send the completed form directly to the school office.
directly.zh: 請把填好的表格直接送到校務處。

director.en: The director explained the main idea behind the short film.
director.zh: 導演說明了這部短片背後的主要概念。

dirty.en: The water looked dirty after the heavy rain.
dirty.zh: 大雨過後，水看起來很髒。

disagree.en: Students may disagree while still respecting one another.
disagree.zh: 學生可以有不同意見，同時仍彼此尊重。

disappear.en: The clouds began to disappear as the weather improved.
disappear.zh: 天氣好轉時，雲開始散去。

disappoint.en: The canceled trip will disappoint many students who were excited about it.
disappoint.zh: 取消這趟旅行會讓許多期待已久的學生失望。

disappointed.en: She felt disappointed after missing the final question by one point.
disappointed.zh: 她因為差一分答對最後一題而感到失望。

disaster.en: The town created a new emergency plan after the natural disaster.
disaster.zh: 這個城鎮在天然災害後制定了新的緊急應變計畫。

discipline.en: Regular practice requires patience and self-discipline.
discipline.zh: 規律練習需要耐心和自律。

discount.en: Students receive a discount when buying tickets with school identification.
discount.zh: 學生出示學生證購票可享折扣。

discover.en: Scientists may discover new patterns when they compare enough data.
discover.zh: 科學家比較足夠資料時可能發現新的模式。

discovery.en: The discovery led researchers to ask several new questions.
discovery.zh: 這項發現使研究人員提出了幾個新問題。

discuss.en: The class will discuss the article after everyone finishes reading it.
discuss.zh: 等大家讀完文章後，全班會一起討論。

discussion.en: The discussion became more useful after students began using evidence.
discussion.zh: 學生開始使用證據後，討論變得更有意義。

disease.en: Regular exercise can reduce the risk of several diseases.
disease.zh: 規律運動可以降低罹患多種疾病的風險。

dish.en: This dish is made with rice, vegetables, and fresh fish.
dish.zh: 這道料理由米飯、蔬菜和新鮮魚類製成。

disk.en: The file was saved on an external disk for backup.
disk.zh: 這個檔案被儲存在外接磁碟中作為備份。

display.en: The screen will display your score after the quiz ends.
display.zh: 小考結束後，螢幕會顯示你的分數。

distance.en: The distance between the two stations is about five kilometers.
distance.zh: 兩個車站之間的距離約五公里。

distant.en: The mountain looked distant even though the sky was clear.
distant.zh: 即使天空晴朗，那座山看起來仍很遙遠。

distinguish.en: Students should learn to distinguish facts from personal opinions.
distinguish.zh: 學生應學會區分事實與個人意見。

distribute.en: The teacher will distribute the worksheets before the activity begins.
distribute.zh: 活動開始前，老師會發下學習單。

distribution.en: The chart shows the distribution of scores across the class.
distribution.zh: 這張圖表顯示全班分數的分布。

district.en: The school is located in a quiet residential district.
district.zh: 這所學校位於安靜的住宅區。

divide.en: Please divide the class into four equal groups.
divide.zh: 請把全班分成四個人數相同的小組。

doctor.en: The doctor advised him to rest and drink more water.
doctor.zh: 醫師建議他多休息並多喝水。

document.en: Please save the document before closing the program.
document.zh: 關閉程式前請先儲存文件。

dog.en: The dog waited quietly outside the store for its owner.
dog.zh: 那隻狗安靜地在店外等主人。

dollar.en: The notebook costs less than ten dollars at this store.
dollar.zh: 這本筆記本在這家店不到十元。

door.en: Please close the door quietly when you leave.
door.zh: 離開時請輕輕把門關上。

double.en: The number of participants nearly doubled compared with last year.
double.zh: 參與人數和去年相比幾乎增加了一倍。

doubt.en: There is little doubt that regular practice improves performance.
doubt.zh: 規律練習能提升表現這件事幾乎沒有疑問。

down.en: Please write the key points down before the discussion ends.
down.zh: 討論結束前請把重點寫下來。

download.en: Students can download the worksheet from the class website.
download.zh: 學生可以從班級網站下載學習單。

dozen.en: The bakery prepared a dozen sandwiches for the school event.
dozen.zh: 麵包店為學校活動準備了十二個三明治。

draft.en: She wrote a first draft before revising her final essay.
draft.zh: 她先寫初稿，再修改成最後的文章。

drag.en: You can drag the file into the folder with the mouse.
drag.zh: 你可以用滑鼠把檔案拖進資料夾。

draw.en: Please draw a simple diagram to explain the process.
draw.zh: 請畫一個簡單圖示來說明這個過程。

dream.en: Her dream is to study marine biology in the future.
dream.zh: 她的夢想是未來學習海洋生物學。

dress.en: Students should dress appropriately for the formal ceremony.
dress.zh: 學生應為正式典禮穿著得體。

drink.en: Remember to drink enough water during long study sessions.
drink.zh: 長時間讀書時記得喝足夠的水。

drive.en: It takes about forty minutes to drive from here to the airport.
drive.zh: 從這裡開車到機場大約需要四十分鐘。

driver.en: The bus driver waited until every student was seated.
driver.zh: 公車司機等到每位學生都坐好才開車。

drop.en: The temperature may drop sharply after sunset in the mountains.
drop.zh: 山區日落後氣溫可能會快速下降。

dry.en: Keep the equipment in a dry place after cleaning it.
dry.zh: 清潔設備後請放在乾燥的地方。

due.en: The assignment is due at the end of next week.

during.en: Please remain quiet during the listening section of the test.
during.zh: 測驗聽力部分進行時請保持安靜。

dust.en: A thin layer of dust covered the unused bookshelf.
dust.zh: 沒使用的書架上覆著一層薄薄的灰塵。

duty.en: It is the monitor's duty to collect the worksheets after class.
duty.zh: 收學習單是班長下課後的職責。

dynamic.en: A dynamic classroom encourages students to ask questions and participate.
dynamic.zh: 有活力的課堂會鼓勵學生提問並參與。
